scope: Unweighted construction on full public RadFoam v1 site arrays. Separate sequential backend processes; no rendering or training speed claim.
cpu: Intel Xeon Platinum 8362 @ 2.80GHz; container quota 4 CPU cores

full_graph_comparison.scope: Full directed adjacency sets. GPU cells are box-clipped; CGAL is full-hull and can include zero-area dual faces at exact ties. Differences alone do not establish errors.

warpower.scope: All Warpower disagreements when their category has at most 20000 directed edges; otherwise uniform fixed-seed samples. Paragram disagreements and shared edges are sampled. Not a complete graph audit. Exact rational LP uses all CGAL neighbors of the owner; native CGAL full-hull triangulation has passed is_valid. Strict positive slack on the candidate bisector proves a positive-area facet inside the backend's float32 clipping box. Zero-area contacts are not adjacency.

interpretation: Times are arithmetic means of ten constructions after three warm-ups, with resident inputs. Compilation, disk I/O, graph comparison, exact LP audits and final CGAL is_valid are excluded.
GPU backends produce box-clipped Voronoi CSR adjacency. CGAL 6.2.1 EPICK constructs the full-hull Delaunay tetrahedralization; build and serial two-pass CSR export are reported separately.
Graph, status, exact facet and CGAL is_valid checks apply to the final measured construction from each backend, not every timed repetition.
Four-thread CGAL measurements encountered cgroup CPU throttling; consult the per-sample counters. Do not treat them as a clean unconstrained four-core performance result.

Full directed graph differences were computed. Exact rational facet LPs audit all Warpower disagreements up to 20000 per category and fixed-seed samples of Paragram disagreements and shared edges. This is not certification of every shared adjacency or a renderer-quality comparison.
Status 3 means empty, which is unexpected for these distinct unweighted sites inside the clipping box. Non-success counts include empty cells; historical failed-cell counts excluded them.
GPU peak memory is approximate device-wide NVML sampling including contexts and allocator reserves. Native CGAL RSS is a separate process metric and is not directly comparable.
